ArtifactKind.description:
A Grimoire-managed artifact kind.

Closed internal enum: the binary is the only consumer, so matches stay
total — no `#[non_exhaustive]`.

oneOf.description:
An Agent Skill: a `SKILL.md` directory with YAML frontmatter.

Also the `Default`: the lock layer's `LockedArtifact::kind` is
`#[serde(skip)]` and re-stamped from the array it was read from, so
the deserialization placeholder is never observed.
A rule: a single `paths:`-scoped markdown file.

An agent: a single markdown file whose required frontmatter
(`name`, `description`) plus optional common fields (`model`,
`tools`) define an AI agent; the body is the system prompt.
Projected per client at install time.

A bundle: a curated set of members (`skill`, `rule`, `agent` or
`mcp`), declared in
`[bundles]` and expanded into its members at resolve time. A bundle
is never materialized or written to the lock itself — only the
members it expands to are.

An MCP server descriptor: a vendor-agnostic definition of a Model
Context Protocol server (transport, command/url, env). Installs by
registering an entry in each client's native MCP config file —
never as a materialized file of its own.

A hook: a directory artifact whose `hook.toml` manifest declares
lifecycle handlers (see [`crate::oci::hook`]). The payload
materializes once per scope; activation is a grim-owned dispatcher
entry registered in each client's own hook surface, never a
per-client copy of the payload.

BundleMember.description: One member of a bundle: a reference to another artifact.

kind.description:
The member kind: `skill`, `rule`, `agent`, or `mcp` — one per
member table of the bundle source. A nested `bundle` is rejected at
expansion time (no recursion in v1).

name.description: The config binding name the member installs under.

BundleProvenance.description:
One bundle that contributed a lock member: the bundle's
`registry/repo` plus the tag the declaration resolved.

tag.description: The declared bundle tag that resolved this member.

Digest.description: A content digest in canonical `algorithm:hex` form (e.g. `sha256:<64 hex>`)

generated_at.description:
RFC3339 UTC timestamp. Preserved verbatim when the resolved
content of every artifact is unchanged between two lock runs.

generated_by.description: Tooling version string that wrote the lock, e.g. `"grim 0.1.0"`.

LockedArtifact.description: One locked artifact, pinned either to a registry manifest digest (`pinned`) or to a local path source (`path` + `hash`, set together) — never both on one entry. Bundle provenance is either the legacy `bundle` + `bundle_tag` pair (set together) or the `bundles` array — never both, and never on a path-sourced entry

bundle.description:
Legacy single-provenance pair: the contributing bundle's
`registry/repo`. Set together with `bundle_tag`; mutually exclusive
with `bundles`.

bundle_tag.description:
Legacy single-provenance pair: the declared bundle tag. Set
together with `bundle`; mutually exclusive with `bundles`.

bundles.description:
Multi-provenance array: every declared bundle that contributed
this member. Mutually exclusive with the `bundle`/`bundle_tag` pair.

hash.description:
Content hash of the path source's canonical packed layer. Set
together with `path`.

path.description:
Local path source (relative to the config file's directory, or
absolute). Set together with `hash`; mutually exclusive with
`pinned`.

pinned.description:
Resolved registry/repo pinned to a content digest. Mutually
exclusive with the `path` + `hash` pair.

LockedBundle.description: One cached bundle expansion, pinned either to a registry manifest digest (`repo` + `tag` + `pinned`, set together) or to a local path source (`path` + `hash`, set together) — never both on one entry

hash.description:
Path arm: the SHA-256 of the canonical members layer. Set together
with `path`.

member.description: The member list the bundle carried at resolution time.

path.description:
Path arm: the declared local path source. Set together with `hash`;
mutually exclusive with the registry arm.

pinned.description:
Registry arm: the resolved bundle manifest digest. Set together with
`repo` and `tag`.

repo.description:
Registry arm: the bundle's `registry/repo`. Set together with `tag`
and `pinned`; mutually exclusive with `path` + `hash`.

tag.description:
Registry arm: the declared tag this expansion resolved. Set together
with `repo` and `pinned`.

PathSource.description: A local path source: `./` or `../` relative to the config file's directory, or an absolute path (forward slashes only)

PinnedIdentifier.description: A fully-qualified OCI reference pinned to a content digest (`registry/repo@sha256:<hex>`; an advisory `:tag` may precede the digest)

description: Raw on-disk shape used for deserialization.
